title: Odd part of a bounded cube function
statement: For a bounded real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, its odd part is the bounded function $x\\mapsto (f(x)-f(-x))/2$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n specifying the dimension of the sign cube
A function on that cube whose values lie in $[-1,1]$
